resources.string: Read-only feasibility experiment: checks accessibility labels in the original Facebook app when you consent. No taps, scrolling, screen capture or stored post text.
Read-only ad candidate and post boundary probe
Read-only diagnostic build: observes Sponsored, ممول, Ad and • Ad when exposed by Facebook accessibility. Observations can repeat for the same ad. No scrolling, hiding or blocking.

Accessibility can technically read on-screen content and interact with apps. FeedVeil Phase 0 uses it only to inspect minimal visible UI labels in the original Facebook app. It does not save post contents, names, passwords, screenshots, or send data anywhere. You can pause or revoke permission at any time.
Only aggregated counters and your local consent/pause settings are stored. No Facebook content is retained. Not affiliated with Meta.
To test, grant access, open the original Facebook app, scroll manually, return here and tap Refresh. Record your observations manually using the Phase 0 test sheet.
Only provisional containers, not verified ads. Placement clusters are not unique ads. No automatic actions.
